main_text.p: patroni ? Lite quidem tam nimis iusta cedere non licet, nisi Deum ipsum (cuius vnius causam dicimus) floccifacere mauelimus : animo autem succumbere, cessimque ire æquè tutum esset, atque animas nostras veritatis diuinæ proditrices, ire perditum : Vnum illud restat (& vna hîc sa-lus) praua Romanæ Ecclesiæ paradoxa, morésq; idolola-tricos strenuè (σὺν Θεῷ, σὺν ἀσπίδι) vsque oppugnare, dum aut illam pudeat, aut se de-nique poeniteat fuisse.

page.notes: The Greek in parentheses is small and partly blurred; the second phrase is uncertain. The word "floccifacere" is printed with an f-like initial and is uncertain. Faint show-through text in the margins and the foot-line "p2-" at lower left are not transcribed; the lower-left mark may be a signature but is too faint to read.
